question: Should bundled/default OpenClaw skill names remain outside ClawHub resolution with a clear explanatory response, or should OpenClaw maintain an explicit trusted mapping from those names to canonical registry references?
rationale: The present 404 follows the registry’s published-slug boundary; choosing implicit aliases, canonical owners, and update ownership is a product and trust-policy decision rather than a mechanical resolver repair.

options.title: Keep registry-only resolution
options.body: Have OpenClaw distinguish bundled/default skills from ClawHub installs and return a clear explanation instead of asking ClawHub to alias names it does not own.

options.title: Maintain explicit default aliases
options.body: Define a versioned OpenClaw-owned mapping to approved owner-qualified ClawHub refs and test its upgrade and collision behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep registry-only resolution
recommendation.body: Have OpenClaw distinguish bundled/default skills from ClawHub installs and return a clear explanation instead of asking ClawHub to alias names it does not own.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged namespace and install-resolution changes make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the owner/alias boundary.
